recognize_zh: 淋巴結結構消失，由小到中型、胞質透明的淋巴球與豐富分支小血管混合浸潤；免疫染色顯示 CD21/CD23 類濾泡樹突細胞網向濾泡外擴張，腫瘤性 T 細胞表現 CD10、PD-1、CXCL13（TFH 表型），流式可見 CD5+CD10+ T 細胞群，符合血管免疫母細胞性 T 細胞淋巴瘤（AITL）。
features: Effaced lymph node architecture with infiltrate extending into perinodal fat
Polymorphous infiltrate of small-to-medium lymphocytes with abundant clear cytoplasm and mildly irregular nuclei
Prominent arborizing high endothelial venules; admixed histiocytes, plasma cells and scattered large immunoblasts
Irregular, expanded extrafollicular follicular dendritic cell meshworks around vessels
Neoplastic T cells CD3+/CD4+/CD5+ with CD10, PD-1 and CXCL13 (TFH) expression; CD8+ cells are small reactive cells
Scattered EBER-positive cells and large CD20+ B blasts in the background
describe_en: Sections of lymph node show effacement of the normal architecture by a diffuse polymorphous infiltrate that extends into perinodal adipose tissue, with residual B-cell areas compressed toward the periphery. At higher power the infiltrate consists of small-to-medium lymphocytes with abundant clear cytoplasm, admixed with prominent arborizing high endothelial venules, histiocytes, other inflammatory cells and scattered large immunoblasts, including occasional mitoses. Immunohistochemistry shows sheets of CD3+, CD4+, CD5+ T cells co-expressing CD10, PD-1 and CXCL13, with scattered CD20+ large B cells, CD8+ small reactive T cells, irregular expanded follicular dendritic cell meshworks outside follicles, scattered large cells highlighted by an unlabeled membranous/Golgi stain (likely CD30), and scattered EBER-positive cells by in situ hybridization. Flow cytometry identifies a CD5+ CD10+ CD19- T-cell population. Findings are consistent with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma (nodal T-follicular helper cell lymphoma, angioimmunoblastic type).

ddx.vs: Scattered CD30+/PAX5+ large cells can mimic Hodgkin cells, but AITL shows an abnormal CD10+/PD-1+ TFH T-cell population with expanded FDC meshworks and T-cell clonality, which cHL lacks.
PTCL-NOS lacks expression of at least two TFH markers (CD10, PD-1, CXCL13, BCL6, ICOS) and does not show the extrafollicular FDC expansion and arborizing HEVs typical of AITL.

ddx.dx: Reactive paracortical hyperplasia / drug or viral lymphadenopathy
ddx.vs: Reactive nodes preserve sinuses and follicles, lack clear-cell TFH cells outside follicles, and show no CD10+ T-cell population by flow or monoclonal TCR rearrangement.

Here the large B cells are scattered EBV-associated bystanders while the neoplastic population is a CD10+/PD-1+ T-cell population, whereas THRLBCL has monoclonal large B cells in a background of non-TFH reactive T cells and histiocytes.

stain: H&E; IHC panel (CD3, CD10, PD-1, CXCL13); ISH: EBER; flow
captions: H&E, medium power: diffuse polymorphous infiltrate of clear-cytoplasm lymphocytes with numerous small vessels
H&E, low power: effaced node with infiltrate extending into perinodal fat
H&E, high power: clear-cell atypical lymphocytes, high endothelial venules, immunoblasts and a mitotic figure
CD20 (low and high power) and CD3: peripherally compressed B-cell areas with scattered large B cells; CD3+ atypical T cells
Unlabeled FDC marker (e.g. CD21/CD23): irregular expanded extrafollicular dendritic cell meshworks around vessels
CD4, CD5 and CD8: atypical T cells CD4+/CD5+; CD8 marks small reactive T cells
CD10, PD-1 and CXCL13: TFH marker expression by neoplastic T cells
Flow cytometry: CD5+ CD10+ CD19- T-cell population (open arrow) and a small CD19+ B-cell population (arrow)
Unlabeled IHC (likely CD30): scattered large cells with membranous and Golgi-type staining
EBER in situ hybridization: scattered EBV-positive cells
